ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهِ الَّذِيْ أَزْهَرَتْ بِبَرَكَتِهِ الرِّيَاضُ .
tr: Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Alladhī azharat bi barakatihi ‘r-riyād.
en: O Allah send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family by whose blessing gardens bloom!

ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهِ صَاحِبِ الْمَدَدِ الْفَيَّاضِ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Ṣāhibi ‘l-madadi ‘l-fayyād.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family, the one of overflowing resource!

ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهِ الَّذِيْ أَعْرَضَ عَمَّا سِوَى اللّٰهِ كُلَّ الْإِعْرَاضِ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Alladhī a`raḍa `ammā siwā ‘lLāhi kulla ‘l-i`rāḍ.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family who turned away from all save Allah at every turn!
